== Title ==
<span lang="ja">エコー基地兵員士官</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。同じ位置に配備するならエコー基地兵員は配備コスト－１。自分の兵員／トルーパーは士官がいるホスの同じ位置に向かってリアクションとして移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍の特殊要員のほとんどは、トレイ・ケイラムと同じように脱走してきた元帝国軍士官だ。兵員士官たちは反乱軍の乏しい物資を有効に活用する手腕に優れている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Echo Base Trooper Officer.

'''Lore''' — Most Rebel specialists are former Imperial officers who defected, as Trey Callum did. Trooper officers excel at making good use of the Rebellion’s scarce supplies.

'''Game text''' — Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Echo Base Troopers deploy for 1 less at the same location. Your troopers may move as a react to the same Hoth location as the officer.

The Japanese uses location in both clauses where the English uses site. The Japanese lore says most Rebel specialists are defectors; the English says many.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-echobasetrooperofficer.gif|Original English face]], [[Echo Base Trooper Officer]].</ref>
